'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] [[Shell (projectile)|shell]] the city of [[Kherson]], killing at least ten [[civilian]]s and injuring 58 others. [https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/1713555/ukraine-live-Vladimir-putin-vows-to-end-war-russia-kremlin-zelensky-updates (''Daily Express'')]
*[[2022 Paris shooting#Aftermath|Aftermath of the 2022 Paris shooting]]
**[[Kurds in France|Kurds]] riot near the [[Place de la République]] in [[Paris]], [[France]], damaging shops and [[arson|setting fires]]. The [[Paris Police Prefecture]] reports 11 arrests and at least 30 minor injuries in relation to the violence. The riot followed a peaceful protest in response to yesterday's [[mass shooting]] at a Kurdish [[cultural center]] that killed three people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/frances-kurds-gather-protest-after-paris-killings-2022-12-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Kemerovo nursing home fire]]
**A fire at an unregistered [[nursing home]] in [[Kemerovo]], [[Russia]], kills 22 people and injures six others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-unregistered-russian-home-elderly-kills-11-tass-2022-12-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boksburg explosion]]
**A [[fuel tanker]] [[explode]]s in [[Boksburg]], [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]], killing 15 people, injuring 27 others, and damaging a nearby hospital. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/24/nine-killed-in-fuel-tanker-explosion-near-johannesburg-official (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 Galicia bus crash]]
**Six people are killed and two others are rescued after a bus falls off a bridge into the [[Lérez]] river in [[Galicia (Spain)|Galicia]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/dec/25/spain-bus-plunges-off-bridge-lerez-river-galicia (''The Guardian'')]
*[[December 2022 North American winter storm]]
**Four people are killed and 36 others are injured in a bus crash on [[British Columbia Highway 97C|Highway 97C]] in [[British Columbia]], Canada. The crash was attributed to "icy roads" following the winter storm. [https://news.sky.com/story/us-bomb-cyclone-at-least-50-dead-as-north-america-gripped-by-devastating-winter-storm-12774427 (Sky News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Assassination of Shinzo Abe#Aftermath|Aftermath of the assassination of Shinzo Abe]]
**The Nara District Public Prosecutors Office in [[Nara Prefecture]], [[Japan]], says that the accused [[assassin]] of former [[Prime Minister of Japan|prime minister]] [[Shinzo Abe]] is competent to stand trial for the killing. [[Prosecutor]]s say that Tetsuya Yamagami "does not suffer from any [[mental illness]] that could greatly affect his ability to judge right from wrong". According to sources, prosecutors plan to indict Yamagami on [[murder]] [[criminal charge|charges]]. [https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/crime-courts/20221224-79396/ (Yomiuri)]
*[[Treatment of women by the Taliban]]
**The [[Taliban]] issues a decree banning female employees from all [[non-governmental organization]]s in [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/taliban-orders-ngos-to-ban-female-employees-from-coming-to-work/ar-AA15DkBc (CNN)]
*[[Wallasey pub shooting]]
**One person is killed and four others are injured during a mass shooting at a pub in [[Wallasey]], [[Merseyside]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-64090038 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Fijian general election#Aftermath|Aftermath of the 2022 Fijian general election]]
**[[Sitiveni Rabuka]] is confirmed as the new [[Prime Minister of Fiji|prime minister]]. Rabuka will hold the office again more than two decades after first leading the country as prime minister. [https://www.voanews.com/a/rabuka-confirmed-as-fiji-prime-minister-after-close-election-/6889980.html (AP via VOA)]
